triggers.name: new_row
triggers.title: New row
triggers.description: New row in a table in JDBC source
triggers.help: Triggers when a row is inserted in the selected table. Checks for new rows every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only the first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: primary_key
input.label: Unique key
input.hint: Select a unique key column to deduplicate rows. Performance can be improved if the selected unique key is indexed.

input.name: output_columns
input.label: Output columns
input.hint: Choose columns to be returned from the selected table. Leave blank to return all columns.

input.name: where
input.label: WHERE condition
input.hint: Rows matching this condition will be processed, e.g. currency = 'USD' (enclose strings in single quotes)

triggers.name: new_rows_batch
triggers.title: New rows
triggers.description: New batch of rows in a table in JDBC source
triggers.help: Triggers when rows are inserted in the selected table. These rows will be processed in batches. If less rows are available, trigger will deliver as a smaller batch. You can configure the batch size to be any number between 1 and 1000. Default batch size is 100.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only the first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

triggers.name: new_rows_sql_batch
triggers.title: New rows via custom SQL
triggers.description: New batch of rows via custom SQL in JDBC source
triggers.help: Triggers when rows matching SQL query are inserted. These rows will be processed in batches. If less rows are available, trigger will deliver as a smaller batch. You can configure the batch size to be any number between 1 and 1000. Default batch size is 100. This trigger does not support SQL Server …

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: sql
input.label: SQL
input.hint: Put your native SQL query here. Avoid using any restrictive clauses like TOP(N) or LIMIT N .

input.name: output_schema
input.label: Output fields
input.hint: Use this to manually define the columns returned in your query. Only needed when queries take too long.

triggers.name: scheduled_select
triggers.title: Scheduled query
triggers.description: Scheduled query using custom SQL in JDBC source
triggers.help: Execute SQL query on specified schedule. Rows matching the SQL query will be processed in batches. If less rows are available, trigger will deliver as a smaller batch. You can configure the batch size to be any number between 1 and 1000. Default batch size is 100.

input.name: sql
input.label: SQL
input.hint: Provide a valid SQL string to be executed on each scheduled time. Use meaningful column aliases. If an indexed unique key of query execution result is not provided you are required to have an ‘ORDER B…

input.name: unique_key
input.label: Indexed unique key
input.hint: Provide an indexed unique key of query execution result to make execution more efficient. For queries that return more than 1000 rows, this is highly recommended to reduce load on your database

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Minimum is 1, maximum is 20000, default is 100

input.name: output_schema
input.label: Output fields
input.hint: Use this to manually define the columns returned in your query. Only needed when queries take too long.

actions.name: export_csv_v2
actions.title: Export query result
actions.description: Export query result as a CSV file in JDBC source
actions.help: This action executes a SQL query and exports the result into a CSV file. This action is intended to write SQL(SELECT) queries.

input.name: sql
input.label: SQL
input.hint: Export the results of this SQL (SELECT) query.

input.name: delimiter
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: The delimiter character that separates each column in the CSV file. CSV files typically use comma .

input.name: target_url
input.label: Upload URL
input.hint: Export the CSV file to this URL. Use the output of Generate on-prem file URL or an S3 presigned URL (with PUT method).

actions.name: insert_rows_batch
actions.title: Insert rows
actions.description: Insert batch of rows in a table in JDBC source
actions.help: Inserts a batch of rows in the selected table. Select the table, then provide data for the rows. Note: This action requires OPA version 31.0 or higher.

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: return_pk
input.label: Return primary keys?
input.hint: Specify whether to return primary keys of inserted rows in the action output. Not returning primary keys can improve performance. Defaults to Yes .

actions.name: run_custom_sql
actions.title: Run custom SQL
actions.description: Run custom SQL in JDBC source
actions.help: Execute a SQL in JDBC source. Provide a valid SQL string and define the expected output fields. This action is intended for write SQL (INSERT and UPDATE) and DDL (CREATE, ALTER and DROP). Maximum number of rows returned in this action is 50000. For SELECT queries, you may use Select rows using custo…

input.name: sql
input.label: SQL
input.hint: Provide a valid SQL string to be executed here. Use bind variables, e.g. id = :id , and the parameter field to parameterize inputs.

input.name: update_only
input.label: Execute update only SQL statement without row limit
input.hint: Defaults to No. When Yes, this action imposes no row limits on SQL statements but returns no rows. Use this to do bulk transformations of data.

input.name: parameters
input.label: Parameters
input.hint: First provide the full name assigned to your bind variable in the WHERE condition. e.g. id Second, provide the actual parameter value. Parameter values can be static or datapills. Select the closest c…

actions.name: run_custom_sql_async_v2
actions.title: Run long query using custom SQL
actions.description: Run long query using custom SQL in JDBC source
actions.help: Execute a SQL in JDBC source asynchronously. Provide a valid SQL string and define the expected output fields. This action is intended to write DML statements (INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE) and DDL statements (CREATE, ALTER and DROP). Query size limit excluding parameters is 1MB. ** For SELECT statemen…

input.name: sql
input.label: SQL
input.hint: Provide a valid SQL string to be executed here.

input.name: update_only
input.label: Update only query?
input.hint: When Yes, this action will execute the query without returning any rows. Use this to do bulk transformations of data.

input.name: timeout
input.label: Timeout limit (minutes)
input.hint: Set an upper limit for this wait action. If one or more of the async jobs take longer than this, proceed to the next step without waiting. Maximum is 1440 minutes (24 hours).

input.label: Table
input.hint: Only the first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: output_columns
input.label: Output columns
input.hint: Choose columns to be selected from the table. Default is to return all columns.

input.name: where
input.label: WHERE condition
input.hint: Rows matching this condition will be selected, e.g. currency = 'USD' (enclose strings in single quotes). Use bind variables, e.g. id = :id , and the parameter field to parameterize inputs.

input.name: orderby
input.label: Order by
input.hint: Order of rows to return. e.g. updated_at DESC

input.name: limit
input.label: Limit
input.hint: Max number of rows to return. Limit is 50000 and default is 100.

input.name: offset
input.label: Offset
input.hint: Number of rows to skip. e.g. 100 .
